newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovnaft, Raytheon in refinery deal.
newsitem.headline: Slovnaft, Raytheon in refinery deal.

text.p: Slovakia's sole crude oil refiner Slovnaft a.s. said Tuesday it had signed a contract worth about $130 million with a Raytheon Corp. unit to upgrade its Bratislava refinery.
The contract with Raytheon Engineers & Constructors is one of the largest within Slovnaft's major heavy residue process ugrading project which is expected to be completed in early 1999.
Slovnaft refined about 36 million barrels of crude oil last year, and is expected to process about the same volume this year, it said.
Raytheon's stock rose 50 cents to $52 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
